exploratoryNote: These results are exploratory: this test split was scored before. Every label is a DFT calculation, not a measurement.
intro: Crystal-graph neural networks and tuned tree models were trained on DFT-calculated properties from JARVIS-DFT. The test is on held-out chemical systems: every crystal whose element combination is in the test set is absent from training. The networks use the fixed neighbour rule. Lower error is better.
